gc_enabled.description: Enable background garbage collection for cached derivatives.

clear_permanent_transforms.description: Allow eviction of permanent transforms during cache pruning.

max_size_bytes.description: Maximum cache disk budget in bytes (default 10 GB).

max_age_days.description: Max age in days for unaccessed cache entries before cleanup.

cleanup_interval_minutes.description: Interval in minutes between automatic cache garbage collection sweeps.

trash_max_age_days.description: Retention period in days for soft-deleted items in trash before purge.

images.description: HTTP caching header parameters for image responses.

location.description: Database host name or connection location.

password.description: Database password (prefer using DB_PASSWORD environment variable).

max_open_conns.description:
MaxOpenConns is the maximum number of open connections to the database.
Default: 25. Set to 0 for unlimited (not recommended in production).

max_idle_conns.description:
MaxIdleConns is the maximum number of idle connections kept in the pool.
Default: 25. Should be ≤ MaxOpenConns.

conn_max_lifetime_minutes.description:
ConnMaxLifetimeMinutes is how long (in minutes) a connection may be reused
before being recycled. Default: 5. Prevents stale connections from being
held open past server-side or load-balancer timeouts.

zip_export_name.description: Default base filename for downloaded ZIP archives.

http_max_age_seconds.description: Cache-Control max-age header in seconds for standard derivative images (default 7 days).

http_permanent_max_age_seconds.description: Cache-Control max-age header in seconds for immutable permanent assets (default 1 year).

match_system_logging.description: Route libvips internal logs through application structured logging.

cache_max_memory_mb.description: Maximum memory limit in MB for libvips operation cache (0 disables cache).

cache_max_files.description: Maximum open files tracked in libvips operation cache (0 disables cache).

cache_max_operations.description: Maximum operations retained in libvips cache (0 disables cache).

vector_enabled.description: Enable SIMD vectorization in libvips image transformations.

pretty.description: Enable colorized human-readable console logging instead of structured JSON.

argon2_memory_mb.description: Memory cost parameter in MB for Argon2id password hashing (RFC 9106 recommended: 64MB).

argon2_time.description: Time cost (iterations) for Argon2id password hashing (RFC 9106 recommended: 3).

argon2_threads.description: Parallelism threads for Argon2id password hashing (RFC 9106 recommended: 4).

host.description: Host or IP the HTTP server binds to (e.g. 'localhost' or '0.0.0.0').

port.description: TCP port the API server listens on.

key.description: Server identification key or authentication secret.

storage_path_template.description: Template format for organizing asset storage paths.

interval_seconds.description: Interval in seconds between storage metrics calculation runs.

location.description: Directory name or path where uploaded files are placed.

allow_manual_registration.description: Allow new users to sign up manually from the UI.

server.description: HTTP server host and port settings.

base_url.description: Base URL of the application instance (e.g. 'localhost' or 'https://photos.example.com').

allowed_hosts.description: Hostnames and IP addresses the server is allowed to respond to.

base_directory.description: Base filesystem directory path for storing application data, assets, and caches.

download.description: Asset download and bulk export settings.

database.description: PostgreSQL database connection and pool settings.

redis.description: Redis connection settings for background task queues and caching.

cache.description: Derivative asset caching and garbage collection settings.

$schema.description: Path or URI to the JSON Schema for editor validation and autocompletion.

title: Viz Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema specification for viz.json runtime configuration file.
